notes.title: [Released]Wizdom
notes.notes:
Wizdom 1.0 has been released.

It supports English, Japanese, and Russian.
For review-related content such as impressions, please use the review column at the bottom of the store page.
We especially need reviews regarding the level of difficulty.

[b]Other information[/b]
1) Overall operation check is not smooth.
There is also the possibility that unexpected errors may occur
2) Verification of player skill operation
It is possible that things are not going smoothly and it may not be activated.
3) The maintenance of monster characters is not going well.
If you encounter a stationary enemy, please let us know.

note that
